A. AUTHORITATIVE MARK SOURCE AND PRECEDENCE
Existing leader fill.price, fill.limit_price, poll payload bid/ask and cached executable get_public_quote are NOT mark-price authority. They are not eligible for F3 fixed-sleeve mint. The existing Build3 mint path is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE until corrected.
For each admitted, genuine, deduplicated post-baseline OPEN/INCREASE or opposite-side FLIP, allow ONLY Hyperliquid's exchange-authored PERPETUAL markPx from a freshly requested POST /info {type:"metaAndAssetCtxs", dex:<exact perp DEX>} response, obtained through the existing service HTTP/client and configured exchange environment. Resolve instrument using the same DEX and the paired meta.universe/index -> assetCtx mapping, not a bare coincident symbol, and require positive finite markPx. This covers default DEX and builder/HIP-3 perps using their exact dex. Testnet proof must use the configured testnet quote environment; no cross-environment mixing. Do NOT substitute mark with midPx, oraclePx, last trade, leader fill/limit, payload ask/bid, or a different DEX.
This grants a narrow existing-Hyperliquid-source adapter, NOT a new price platform, dependency, process, store or send path. Do not add a WebSocket alternative under C2B.

B. FRESHNESS AND FAILURE CONTRACT
The official metaAndAssetCtxs mark context does not provide a per-mark exchange creation timestamp. Do not fabricate one or claim independently verified exchange-generation age. For this permitted synchronous exchange read, use a local monotonic clock to record request-start, response-received and mint-consumed instants. Request must start AFTER the genuine event passes lineage/dedupe admission and BEFORE mint; successful response round-trip must be <=1000 ms, and consumption must occur <=1000 ms after response receipt. Enforce a bounded HTTP timeout <=1000 ms. Do not reuse an earlier event's response or any unproven cache. Local wall-clock timestamp is for audit only; monotonic intervals determine age. Record environment, DEX, coin mapping, exact markPx, source, start/receive/consume times, and validation outcome in existing audit machinery, not a new authority store.
If another response type is later proposed with a native exchange timestamp, that source is NOT approved by this ruling; separately prove it and enforce age <=1000 ms, rejecting missing, stale, invalid or future timestamps (allowing at most 250 ms explicit clock skew). For the approved synchronous REST route, absent native exchange timestamp is acceptable ONLY with the bounded local request/receipt proof; absent local timing is never acceptable.
Any timeout, stale/late receipt, missing/null/nonfinite/nonpositive mark, malformed metadata, missing/ambiguous coin-to-DEX mapping, wrong environment, incomplete read, or contradictory exchange mark data for the same exact market/observation => FIXED_MARK_AUTHORITY_HOLD. Never silently fall back. Executable bid/ask naturally differs from mark and is NOT an alternative mark or automatically a contradictory source; existing executable-price, slippage, minimum-order and risk gates still apply separately.

C. SAFE FAILURE / F1-F10 PRECEDENCE
No valid mark => ZERO new fixed OPEN/INCREASE/FLIP opposite-side slice, ZERO new associated order authority, and no checkpoint may falsely record an unminted slice as completed. Preserve the pending original authenticated event without letting replay, snapshot, current positions or restart create NEW authority. Genuine REDUCE/CLOSE of an already attributed sleeve is NOT gated on availability of a new mint mark; it remains subject to existing durable sleeve lineage, account-net, price-to-execute, one-order-site, reconciliation, G2/G3 and risk checks. On FLIP, safe old-side close may proceed only if its durable stage and pending new-side event are separately exactly-once provable in the existing SERVICE_STATE_FILE; otherwise HOLD the entire flip atomically rather than send an unsafe/duplicated side. No snapshot-based size inference, unrelated-inventory change, proportional-mode change or G1-G3 waiver.

D. SINGLE NEXT BOUNDED CONTROLLER GATE
Authorise G4-C2B only: Hermes implements the minimal on-demand /info metaAndAssetCtxs markPx acquisition and validation at existing fixed-mint authority seam, with deterministic injected-response tests. Exercise default and HIP-3 DEX identity, valid event, stale/slow/no-response, absent/future/invalid timing, missing/bad mark, wrong market, no fallback to fill/limit/bid/ask, no mint/order/in-flight/simulated mutation on hold, ordinary REDUCE/CLOSE not unnecessarily blocked, and FLIP exactly-once safety. Keep existing G2/G3 and G4-C1 regression passes, single order site and existing state store; refresh the existing Graphify artifact after product changes. Any scope-budget or invariant breach must return ARCHITECT_REVIEW_REQUIRED before enlargement. Hermes commits/pushes exact code/tests/evidence and one correlated RESULT to Controller; Controller alone adjudicates PASS/FAIL and next action. No unrelated G4 UI/lifecycle work in this packet, no G5, no live/mainnet activation.
